description: Seeded C determinism/crash replay fixture that pins the fuzz harness counterexample format and report contract; it does not measure Rust parity.

minimization.notes: Add minimized C sanitizer crashes or determinism failures with the same schema and expected C counters. make fuzz-minimize retains live DSL v2 Rust-vs-C counterexamples under build/fuzz_v2/seed-<seed>/minimized; fixed divergences become genuine regression captures in fixtures/rust_reference_v2.
